metadata.title: Admin Guide: Adding New Users
metadata.description: Step-by-step guide for administrators to add new users to the system
metadata.author: System Administrator

sections.title: Navigate to User Management
sections.content:
Step 1: Access User Management Module

From the main dashboard, click on the Users menu item in the sidebar.

This will open the User Management page showing a list of existing users.

sections.title: Open Add User Dialog
sections.content:
Step 2: Click Add User Button

In the User Management page, locate and click the Add User button in the top-right corner.

A dialog will appear with a form containing the following fields:

  • Full Name (required)
  • Email (required)
  • Username (required)
  • Password (required)
  • Role (required)
  • Owner/Company (for non-admin users)
  • Status (Active/Inactive)

sections.title: Fill User Information
sections.content:
Step 3: Enter User Details

Fill in all required fields:

  1. Full Name: Enter the user's full name
  2. Email: Enter a valid email address
  3. Username: Choose a unique username (no spaces)
  4. Password: Enter a secure password (min 8 characters)
  5. Role: Select appropriate role:
    • Super Admin - Full system access
    • Admin - Company-wide access
    • Owner - Multi-project access
    • User - Limited access
Important: For Owner and User roles, you must select their company/owner.

codeSnippets.code:
Password Requirements:
- Minimum 8 characters
- At least 1 uppercase letter
- At least 1 lowercase letter
- At least 1 number
- At least 1 special character
codeSnippets.description: Password must meet these security requirements

sections.title: Save and Verify
sections.content:
Step 4: Create User

After filling all required fields:

  1. Review all information for accuracy
  2. Click the Save button
  3. Wait for confirmation message

Upon successful creation:

  • The new user will appear in the user list
  • A confirmation email will be sent to the user's email address
  • The user can now login with their credentials
Tip: You can edit user details later by clicking the edit icon next to their name.

sections.title: Common Issues and Solutions
sections.content:
Troubleshooting

Email Already Exists

If you see "Email already exists" error, the email is already registered. Use a different email or check if the user already exists.

Username Taken

Choose a different username if you get "Username already taken" error.

Permission Denied

Ensure you have admin privileges. Contact your Super Admin if you can't add users.

Owner Not Available

If you can't select an owner, make sure at least one owner record exists in the system.
